stock.description: Easyhold Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates restaurants in Hong Kong and People's Republic of China. The company offers Cantonese dining and banquet services, including wedding banquet services. It operates Chinese full-service restaurants under the Palace, Royal Courtyard, and Sea Moon Cuisine brand names. The company was formerly known as Welife Technology Limited and changed its name to Easyhold Group Holdings Limited in March 2026. Easyhold Group Holdings Limited was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
